tools.name: SendFeedback
tools.description:
Use this tool to draft feedback about Claude Code when you hit a high-signal moment. That includes both PRODUCT issues and MODEL-BEHAVIOR issues:
- a reproducible tool or product failure was just resolved or abandoned
- the user clearly expressed frustration with Claude Code or with how you handled the task
- you hit a missing capability that blocked a reasonable request
- you notice, or the user points out, that your own behavior in this session went wrong, for example: you gave a confident answer then had to retract it; you stopped short and handed work back when you could have finished; you declined or disputed a reasonable request; you spawned more subagents than the task warranted; your tone was off; you asked more clarifying questions than needed; you expanded scope beyond what was asked

The draft is QUEUED LOCALLY. It is never sent without the user's explicit approval, and calling this tool renders no UI and does not interrupt the conversation, so never announce it or ask the user about it mid-task.

Write `details` as short labeled bullets in this exact order, one to three lines each, no narrative paragraphs:
- **What happened:** the observed behavior vs. what was expected, with exact error text if short. Facts only.
- **What the user said:** the user's own words that prompted this, quoted. If nothing did, write "User didn't comment; observed by the model." Never paraphrase sentiment into a stronger claim.
- **Repro:** the minimal steps or shape that reproduces it.
- **Evidence:** identifiers a reader can chase, such as request IDs, timestamps, file paths, versions. Omit the bullet if there are none.

Constraints:
- Never fabricate or exaggerate user sentiment; report only what actually happened.
- Everything in the draft must be sourced from the user or the session, never inferred: leave unknown fields blank rather than guess, and add a final **Cause:** bullet only for a root cause you verified in-session.
- Use `area` to name the part of Claude Code the feedback is about (a feature, command, or workflow, e.g. "hooks config", "/help", "file editing") when there is a clear one; leave it blank otherwise.
- Use `failure_mode` ONLY when the report is about model behavior (how Claude responded), not a product bug. Pick the single closest value, or `other` when it is a model-behavior issue that fits no listed value; omit the field only when the report is a product/tool bug with no model-behavior component.
- Use `task_category` to name what kind of task the session was doing, or `other` when it is a clear task that fits no listed value. Omit only if genuinely unclear.
- Do not include secrets or credentials. Refer to people by role ("a teammate", "the PR reviewer"), never by name, email address, or chat/user ID. This applies inside quoted user words too: replace a name or handle with a bracketed role (e.g. "[a teammate]") and keep the rest verbatim. Do not include customer-facing channel or DM IDs, or excerpts of customer content. Session, request, and run IDs, timestamps, repo/PR numbers, and file paths (written relative to the working directory, or ~-prefixed, not absolute paths under the user's home) remain the right evidence.
- If the issue looks like a security vulnerability: describe the class of problem, never a working exploit or step-by-step extraction path.
- Draft only at the natural moments listed above, and at most one draft per distinct issue; never re-draft the same issue in a session.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

# Plan: resto de arquetipos de criaturas + fallback vanilla

## Context
El dragón (1 modelo, máscara + `variants.json`, 40 monstruos) ya funciona y se ve bien en el juego. Falta el resto de arquetipos del plan aprobado. Decisiones del usuario:
- **Fallback = entidad vanilla.** Cada monstruo conserva su `baseEntity` vanilla. Esa entidad se usa si los modelos propios están desactivados por config, si un skin pack de otro mod aplica, o si el modelo no existe en el cliente.
- **Cobertura: solo los que encajan.** Los demás (caballos, ciervos, peces, humanos con equipo…) siguen con su vanilla, que ya se ve bien.

## 1. Fallback (Java, pequeño)
- **`monsters.json`**
  - `baseEntity` vuelve a ser siempre vanilla: los 40 dragones vuelven a `minecraft:ravager`.
  - Optar por un modelo propio = solo `appearance.model` (+ `variant`).
- **`MonsterRegistry.spawnAt`** (`MonsterRegistry.java:762`)
  - Usa `DndsheetsModEntities.MONSTER_MODEL` cuando se cumple a la vez:
    - `appearance.model() != null`;
    - `Config.ownCreatureModels()` está activo;
    - `baseEntityId` sigue siendo el del JSON (no lo cambió un reskin).
  - Si no, usa `baseEntity`, como hoy.
  - `applyLooks` ya ignora `model`/`variant` en entidades vanilla.
- **`MonsterRegistry.reskin`** (l.238): al reemplazar, pone `model = null` en el `Appearance` copiado, así el skin pack gana sin más lógica.
- **`Config.java`**: `ownCreatureModels = builder.define("ownCreatureModels", true)`, mismo patrón que `adoptVanillaMobs` (l.144), más su getter y las claves de lang.
- **Cliente** (`MonsterModelRenderer.Model`)
  - Si `GeckoLibCache.getBakedModels()` no contiene `geo/entity/<model>.geo.json` (por ejemplo, un resource pack lo quitó), usa `MonsterModelEntity.DEFAULT_MODEL` en geo, animación y textura, y deja un aviso en el log una sola vez.
  - Hoy GeckoLib crashea en ese caso.
- **Animación de ataque**: llamar `MonsterModelEntity.play(monsterEntity, "attack")` al inicio de `MonsterActionManager.resolveAttack` (l.522). Es el embudo único: acción, legendaria y de oportunidad pasan por ahí.
- **Self-test** (`JsonContentSelfTest`): un monstruo con `appearance.model` debe tener un `baseEntity` vanilla existente (≠ `dndsheets:monster_model`). Se mantienen las comprobaciones de geo, animación, máscara y variante.

## 2. Arquetipos: planes corporales compartidos
Para no escribir 14 scripts a mano, se añaden constructores paramétricos en `tools/blockbench/mobs/mobkit.py`. Cada arquetipo es un script corto en `tools/blockbench/mobs/<nombre>.py` (patrón `dragon.py`): parámetros + extras (orejas, colmillos, cuernos, cola, alas) + paletas, todo con `Archetype(...).run()`. Los cubos reutilizan la máscara por roles (`base`/`dark`/`belly`/`horn`/`membrane`/`eye`). Las animaciones se escriben una vez por plan corporal con las claves `idle fly attack hurt death`.

| Plan corporal | Arquetipo | Monstruos (variante = paleta, tamaño = `size` / Pehkui) |
|---|---|---|
| biped | `goblinoid` | goblin, hobgoblin, bugbear, duergar, deep_gnome |
| biped | `brute` | orc, ogre, troll, minotaur, oni, gigantes hill/stone/frost/fire/cloud |
| biped | `reptilian` | kobold, lizardfolk |
| biped | `demon` (cuernos, alas, cola) | diablos barbed, bearded, horned, bone, chain, ice, pit fiend, erinyes; balor, imp, quasit |
| biped | `undead` (enjuto) | zombie, ghoul, ghast, wight, mummy, mummy_lord, vampire_spawn |
| biped | `golem` (macizo) | clay, flesh, iron, stone golem, shield_guardian, earth_elemental |
| quadruped | `beast` | lobos (wolf, dire, worg, winter, hell hound, blink/death dog, mastiff), hienas, jackal, werewolf_wolf, felinos (lion, tiger, panther, saber-toothed) |
| quadruped low | `reptile` | crocodile, giant_crocodile, lizard, giant_lizard, basilisk |
| segmented | `serpent` | serpientes (constrictor, poisonous, giant), flying_snake, guardian/spirit naga, purple_worm |
| 8 patas | `spider` | spider, giant_spider, giant_wolf_spider, phase_spider, swarm_of_spiders |
| blob | `ooze` | gray_ooze, ochre_jelly, black_pudding, gelatinous_cube |
| floating | `elemental` | fire, air, water elemental, mephits, magmin |
| bird | `bird` | hawk, blood_hawk, eagle, giant_eagle, owl, giant_owl, giant_vulture, roc |
| fish | `shark` | hunter, reef, giant shark, killer_whale |

- **Dragón**: se añaden también `pseudodragon` (baby) y `wyvern` como variantes de paleta del dragón existente.
- **Quedan vanilla a propósito**: humanoides con equipo (bandido, guardia, mago…), skeleton/lich, osos, caballos, ciervos, cabras, murciélagos, peces pequeños, pulpos/kraken, aberraciones únicas (aboleth, beholder-like, mimic, roper) y criaturas compuestas (griffon, chimera, hydra, ettin, scorpion).
- **Vuelo**: el `flies` del monstruo ya pone la pose `fly` (bird, demon con alas, imp, mephits).
- **Mapeo exacto**: se fija leyendo `monsters.json` al implementar, con un script de una pasada: `id` → `{model, variant}` y `baseEntity` intacto.

## 3. Docs
- `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`: tabla de arquetipos, fallback, config `ownCreatureModels`.
- `CHANGELOG.md`.
- `CREDITS.md`: todo el arte es procedural y original, sin cambios de política.

## Archivos
- Java:
  - `MonsterRegistry.java` (`spawnAt`, `reskin`)
  - `Config.java`
  - `client/MonsterModelRenderer.java`
  - `MonsterActionManager.java` (`resolveAttack`)
  - `JsonContentSelfTest.java`
- Datos:
  - `src/main/resources/dndsheets/defaults/monsters.json`
  - lang `en_us` / `es_*` (config)
- Herramientas:
  - `tools/blockbench/mobs/mobkit.py` (planes corporales + animaciones por plan)
  - `tools/blockbench/mobs/<arquetipo>.py` ×14
- Assets (por arquetipo): `assets/dndsheets/{geo,animations}/entity/<a>.*.json` y `textures/entity/<a>/{mask.png,variants.json}`

## Verificación
- Correr cada script: `bbmodel_validate` passed y geo exportada.
- `./gradlew build`: `testJsonContent` (archivos, variantes, fallback vanilla), `checkAssetCredits` y `checkPortabilityCoupling`.
- `./gradlew runClient`, una prueba manual del usuario:
  - spawnear un monstruo por arquetipo desde `MonsterSpawnListScreen`: modelo, color, escala, animación idle/attack/hurt/death;
  - con `ownCreatureModels=false`, que aparezca su vanilla;
  - que un reinicio de mundo conserve modelo y variante.
- Los renders headless salen en blanco en esta máquina: la revisión visual es en el juego.

## 1. Fallback (Java, pequeño)
- **`monsters.json`**
  - `baseEntity` vuelve a ser siempre vanilla: los 40 dragones vuelven a `minecraft:ravager`.
  - Optar por un modelo propio = solo `appearance.model` (+ `variant`).
- **`MonsterRegistry.spawnAt`** (`MonsterRegistry.java:762`)
  - Usa `DndsheetsModEntities.MONSTER_MODEL` cuando se cumple a la vez:
    - `appearance.model() != null`;
    - `Config.ownCreatureModels()` está activo;
    - `baseEntityId` sigue siendo el del JSON (no lo cambió un reskin).
  - Si no, usa `baseEntity`, como hoy.

  - Si `GeckoLibCache.getBakedModels()` no contiene `geo/entity/<model>.geo.json` (por ejemplo, un resource pack lo quitó), usa `MonsterModelEntity.DEFAULT_MODEL` en geo, animación y textura, y deja un aviso en el log una sola vez.

| biped | `brute` | orc, ogre, troll, minotaur, oni, gigantes hill/stone/frost/fire/cloud |
| biped | `reptilian` | kobold, lizardfolk |

| 8 patas | `spider` | spider, giant_spider, giant_wolf_spider, phase_spider, swarm_of_spiders |
| blob | `ooze` | gray_ooze, ochre_jelly, black_pudding, gelatinous_cube |
| floating | `elemental` | fire, air, water elemental, mephits, magmin |
| bird | `bird` | hawk, blood_hawk, eagle, giant_eagle, owl, giant_owl, giant_vulture, roc |
| fish | `shark` | hunter, reef, giant shark, killer_whale |

- **Dragón**: se añaden también `pseudodragon` (baby) y `wyvern` como variantes de paleta del dragón existente.
- **Quedan vanilla a propósito**: humanoides con equipo (bandido, guardia, mago…), skeleton/lich, osos, caballos, ciervos, cabras, murciélagos, peces pequeños, pulpos/kraken, aberraciones únicas (aboleth, beholder-like, mimic, roper) y criaturas compuestas (griffon, chimera, hydra, ettin, scorpion).
- **Vuelo**: el `flies` del monstruo ya pone la pose `fly` (bird, demon con alas, imp, mephits).
- **Mapeo exacto**: se fija leyendo `monsters.json` al implementar, con un script de una pasada: `id` → `{model, variant}` y `baseEntity` intacto.

## 3. Docs
- `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`: tabla de arquetipos, fallback, config `ownCreatureModels`.
- `CHANGELOG.md`.
- `CREDITS.md`: todo el arte es procedural y original, sin cambios de política.

## Archivos
- Java:
  - `MonsterRegistry.java` (`spawnAt`, `reskin`)
  - `Config.java`
  - `client/MonsterModelRenderer.java`
  - `MonsterActionManager.java` (`resolveAttack`)
  - `JsonContentSelfTest.java`
- Datos:
  - `src/main/resources/dndsheets/defaults/monsters.json`
  - lang `en_us` / `es_*` (config)
- Herramientas:
  - `tools/blockbench/mobs/mobkit.py` (planes corporales + animaciones por plan)
  - `tools/blockbench/mobs/<arquetipo>.py` ×14
- Assets (por arquetipo): `assets/dndsheets/{geo,animations}/entity/<a>.*.json` y `textures/entity/<a>/{mask.png,variants.json}`

## Verificación
- Correr cada script: `bbmodel_validate` passed y geo exportada.
- `./gradlew build`: `testJsonContent` (archivos, variantes, fallback vanilla), `checkAssetCredits` y `checkPortabilityCoupling`.
- `./gradlew runClient`, una prueba manual del usuario:
  - spawnear un monstruo por arquetipo desde `MonsterSpawnListScreen`: modelo, color, escala, animación idle/attack/hurt/death;
  - con `ownCreatureModels=false`, que aparezca su vanilla;
  - que un reinicio de mundo conserve modelo y variante.

"""Body plans shared by the creature archetypes: each builds bones + cubes from a few proportions and returns the
anchor points the archetype hangs its extras on (ears, horns, tusks, tails, wings), plus one animation set per plan.
So an archetype script is proportions + extras + palettes, and every biped animates the same way.

Conventions (as the dragon): the model faces -Z, +Y is up, '_l' is +X and '_r' its mirror at -X.
Bedrock rotation signs used in the animations: on X, negative swings a hanging limb forward and lifts a forward-pointing
part (jaw tip, neck); positive tilts a standing part (torso, head) forward. On Z, positive lifts a +X limb (left wing)."""
import math
from mobkit import Cube, keys


class Body:
    def __init__(self):
        self.bones, self.cubes = [], []

    def bone(self, name, parent, pivot, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
        self.bones.append((name, parent, list(pivot), list(rot)))

    def bone_pair(self, name, parent_l, parent_r, pivot, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
        x, y, z = pivot
        self.bone(name + '_l', parent_l, (x, y, z), rot)
        self.bone(name + '_r', parent_r, (-x, y, z), (rot[0], -rot[1], -rot[2]))

    def box(self, name, bone, a, b, role='base'):
        self.cubes.append(Cube(name, bone, tuple(a), tuple(b), role))

    def pair(self, name, bone_l, bone_r, a, b, role='base'):
        """Left cube + mirrored right cube sharing one painted net."""
        (ax, ay, az), (bx, by, bz) = a, b
        self.cubes.append(Cube(name + '_l', bone_l, (ax, ay, az), (bx, by, bz), role, uvkey=name))
        self.cubes.append(Cube(name + '_r', bone_r, (-bx, ay, az), (-ax, by, bz), role, uvkey=name))


# --- animation helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def anim(length, bones, loop=True):
    a = {'animation_length': length, 'bones': {b: {ch: keys(length, fr) for ch, fr in chans.items()} for b, chans in bones.items()}}
    a['loop'] = True if loop else 'hold_on_last_frame'
    return a


def sway(length, amp, axis=1, phase=0.0, n=8, base=0.0):
    """A sine loop on one axis, sampled n times (GeckoLib interpolates linearly between)."""
    out = {}
    for i in range(n + 1):
        v = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        v[axis] = round(base + amp * math.sin(2 * math.pi * (i / n + phase)), 2)
        out[round(length * i / n, 3)] = v
    return out


def spin(length, turns=1):
    return {round(length * i / 4, 3): [0, 90 * i * turns, 0] for i in range(5)}


def x(**frames):
    return {float(k[1:].replace('_', '.')): [v, 0, 0] for k, v in frames.items()}


def mirror(chans):
    """The right-side copy of a left-side channel set: Y and Z rotations flip."""
    out = {}
    for ch, frames in chans.items():
        out[ch] = {t: ([v[0], -v[1], -v[2]] if ch == 'rotation' else ([-v[0], v[1], v[2]] if ch == 'position' else v)) for t, v in frames.items()}
    return out


def both(name, chans):
    return {name + '_l': chans, name + '_r': mirror(chans)}


# --- biped ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def biped(leg=(3, 10), gap=1, torso=(8, 10, 5), head=(8, 7, 7), arm=(3, 12), hunch=0, sink=0, head_fwd=0,
          clothes=('torso', 'legs'), arm_rest=0, chest=True):
    """Two legs, torso, head, two arms (with empty item_r/item_l bones at the hands for held items).
    sink: how far the head sits down between the shoulders. Returns (body, info)."""
    b = Body()
    lw, lh = leg
    tw, th, td = torso
    hw, hh, hd = head
    aw, al = arm
    top = lh + th
    hy0 = top - sink
    hz0 = -hd // 2 - head_fwd
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, lh, 0), (hunch, 0, 0))
    b.bone('head', 'body', (0, top, 0), (-round(hunch * 0.7), 0, 0))
    b.bone_pair('arm', 'body', 'body', (tw // 2 + aw // 2, top - 1, 0), (arm_rest, 0, 0))
    b.bone('item_r', 'arm_r', (-(tw // 2 + aw // 2), top - al + 1, -1))
    b.bone('item_l', 'arm_l', (tw // 2 + aw // 2, top - al + 1, -1))
    b.bone_pair('leg', 'root', 'root', (gap + lw // 2, lh, 0))

    half = lw // 2
    b.pair('leg', 'leg_l', 'leg_r', (gap, 1, -half), (gap + lw, lh, lw - half), 'membrane' if 'legs' in clothes else 'base')
    b.pair('foot', 'leg_l', 'leg_r', (gap, 0, -half - 1), (gap + lw, 1, lw - half), 'dark')
    b.box('torso', 'body', (-tw // 2, lh, -td // 2), (tw - tw // 2, top, td - td // 2), 'membrane' if 'torso' in clothes else 'base')
    if chest:
        b.box('chest', 'body', (-tw // 2 + 1, lh + th // 2, -td // 2 - 1), (tw - tw // 2 - 1, top - 1, -td // 2), 'belly')
    b.box('head', 'head', (-hw // 2, hy0, hz0), (hw - hw // 2, hy0 + hh, hz0 + hd))
    ey = hy0 + max(2, hh * 11 // 20)
    b.pair('eye', 'head', 'head', (1, ey, hz0 - 1), (min(3, hw // 2), ey + 1, hz0), 'eye')
    b.pair('arm', 'arm_l', 'arm_r', (tw - tw // 2, top - al, -aw // 2), (tw - tw // 2 + aw, top, aw - aw // 2))
    b.pair('hand', 'arm_l', 'arm_r', (tw - tw // 2, top - al - 1, -aw // 2), (tw - tw // 2 + aw, top - al, aw - aw // 2), 'dark')
    info = dict(lh=lh, top=top, tw=tw, td=td, hw=hw, hh=hh, hd=hd, hx=hw - hw // 2, hy0=hy0, hy1=hy0 + hh, hz0=hz0, hz1=hz0 + hd,
                ey=ey, shoulder=top - 1, back=td - td // 2, aw=aw, al=al)
    return b, info


def biped_tail(b, info, length=12, width=3, tip_role='base', segments=2):
    y = info['lh'] + 1
    z = info['back']
    seg = length // segments
    parent = 'body'
    for i in range(segments):
        w = max(1, width - i)
        name = 'tail%d' % (i + 1)
        b.bone(name, parent, (0, y + w // 2, z), (-35 if i == 0 else 10, 0, 0))
        b.box(name, name, (-(w // 2), y, z), (w - w // 2, y + w, z + seg))
        parent, z = name, z + seg
    b.box('tail_tip', parent, (-1, y - 1, z), (1, y + 2, z + 3), tip_role)


def biped_wings(b, info, span=16, height=12):
    """Bat wings on the back: a bone bar along the top edge and a membrane hanging under it, swept back."""
    sy, z = info['shoulder'], info['back']
    b.bone_pair('wing', 'body', 'body', (2, sy, z), (0, -25, 15))
    b.pair('wing_bar', 'wing_l', 'wing_r', (2, sy - 1, z), (2 + span, sy + 1, z + 2), 'horn')
    b.pair('wing_skin', 'wing_l', 'wing_r', (3, sy - height, z + 1), (2 + span, sy - 1, z + 2), 'membrane')


def horns(b, info, rise=4, out=2, thick=2, curl=True):
    """A pair of horns from the top corners of the head, curling outward and back."""
    hx, y, z = info['hx'], info['hy1'], info['hz0'] + 2
    b.pair('horn', 'head', 'head', (hx - thick, y, z), (hx, y + rise, z + thick), 'horn')
    if curl:
        b.pair('horn_tip', 'head', 'head', (hx, y + rise - thick, z + thick - 1), (hx + out, y + rise, z + thick + 1), 'horn')


def pointed_ears(b, info, length=4):
    hx, y, z = info['hx'], info['ey'], info['hz0'] + 2
    b.pair('ear', 'head', 'head', (hx, y, z), (hx + length, y + 2, z + 1))
    b.pair('ear_tip', 'head', 'head', (hx + length, y + 1, z), (hx + length + 2, y + 3, z + 1), 'dark')


def tusks(b, info):
    y, z = info['hy0'], info['hz0']
    b.pair('tusk', 'head', 'head', (1, y, z - 1), (2, y + 3, z), 'horn')


def brow(b, info):
    hx = info['hx']
    b.box('brow', 'head', (-hx, info['ey'] + 1, info['hz0'] - 1), (hx, info['ey'] + 2, info['hz0']), 'dark')


def snout(b, info, w=4, h=3, length=4, role='base'):
    y, z = info['hy0'], info['hz0']
    b.box('snout', 'head', (-w // 2, y, z - length), (w - w // 2, y + h, z), role)
    b.box('nostril', 'head', (-w // 2, y + h - 1, z - length - 1), (w - w // 2, y + h, z - length), 'dark')


def biped_anims(heavy=False):
    """idle / fly (wings, legs dangling) / attack (right arm overhead swing) / hurt / death (falls on its back)."""
    slow = 1.4 if heavy else 1.0
    return {
        'idle': anim(3.0, {
            'body': {'position': {0: [0, 0, 0], 1.5: [0, 0.4, 0], 3: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'head': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 7)},
            'arm_l': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 3, axis=0)},
            'arm_r': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 3, axis=0, phase=0.5)},
            'tail1': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 12)},
            'tail2': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 16, phase=0.2)},
            'wing_l': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 4, axis=2)},
            'wing_r': {'rotation': sway(3.0, -4, axis=2)},
        }),
        'fly': anim(0.8, {
            'body': {'position': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.4: [0, -1, 0], 0.8: [0, 0, 0]}},
            **both('wing', {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 25], 0.4: [0, 0, -30], 0.8: [0, 0, 25]}}),
            'leg_l': {'rotation': {0: [15, 0, 0], 0.8: [15, 0, 0]}},
            'leg_r': {'rotation': {0: [22, 0, 0], 0.8: [22, 0, 0]}},
            'tail1': {'rotation': sway(0.8, 10)},
        }),
        'attack': anim(0.7 * slow, {
            'arm_r': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.25 * slow: [-140, 0, 0], 0.45 * slow: [-20, 0, 0], 0.7 * slow: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'arm_l': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.25 * slow: [-25, 0, 0], 0.7 * slow: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'body': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.25 * slow: [-6, 12, 0], 0.45 * slow: [10, -14, 0], 0.7 * slow: [0, 0, 0]}},
        }, loop=False),
        'hurt': anim(0.4, {
            'body': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.1: [-10, 0, 0], 0.4: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'head': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.1: [-15, 0, 0], 0.4: [0, 0, 0]}},
        }, loop=False),
        'death': anim(1.2 * slow, {
            'root': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.9 * slow: [-88, 0, 0], 1.2 * slow: [-90, 0, 0]}},
            **both('arm', {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.9 * slow: [-20, 0, 40]}}),
            'head': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.9 * slow: [-15, 0, 0]}},
        }, loop=False),
    }


# --- quadruped -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def quadruped(body=(8, 7, 16), leg=(3, 8), head=(6, 6, 5), muzzle=(4, 3, 4), splay=False, rise=2):
    """Four legs, a body, a head with an upper muzzle and an opening jaw. splay = lizard legs out at the sides."""
    b = Body()
    w, h, l = body
    lw, lh = leg
    hw, hh, hl = head
    mw, mh, ml = muzzle
    cy = lh + h // 2
    hy0 = lh + h - hh // 2 + rise
    hz0 = -l // 2 - hl + 2
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, cy, 0))
    b.bone('head', 'body', (0, hy0 + hh // 2, -l // 2))
    b.bone('jaw', 'head', (0, hy0 + 1, hz0))
    lx = w // 2 + (lw // 2 if splay else -lw // 2)
    fz, bz = -l // 2 + lw // 2 + 1, l // 2 - lw // 2 - 1
    for side, sx in (('l', 1), ('r', -1)):
        b.bone('leg_f' + side, 'body', (sx * lx, lh, fz))
        b.bone('leg_b' + side, 'body', (sx * lx, lh, bz))
    b.box('body', 'body', (-w // 2, lh, -l // 2), (w - w // 2, lh + h, l - l // 2))
    x0 = w - w // 2 if splay else w - w // 2 - lw
    for name, z in (('leg_f', fz), ('leg_b', bz)):
        b.pair(name, name + 'l', name + 'r', (x0, 1, z - lw // 2), (x0 + lw, lh + (1 if splay else 2), z - lw // 2 + lw))
        b.pair(name.replace('leg', 'paw'), name + 'l', name + 'r', (x0, 0, z - lw // 2 - 1), (x0 + lw, 1, z - lw // 2 + lw), 'claw')
    b.box('head', 'head', (-hw // 2, hy0, hz0), (hw - hw // 2, hy0 + hh, hz0 + hl))
    jh = max(1, mh // 3)
    b.box('muzzle', 'head', (-mw // 2, hy0 + jh, hz0 - ml), (mw - mw // 2, hy0 + mh, hz0))
    b.box('nose', 'head', (-1, hy0 + mh - 1, hz0 - ml - 1), (1, hy0 + mh, hz0 - ml), 'dark')
    b.box('jaw', 'jaw', (-mw // 2 + (1 if mw > 3 else 0), hy0, hz0 - ml + 1), (mw - mw // 2 - (1 if mw > 3 else 0), hy0 + jh, hz0), 'belly')
    ey = hy0 + hh - 2
    b.pair('eye', 'head', 'head', (hw // 2 - 2, ey, hz0 - 1), (hw // 2 - 1, ey + 1, hz0), 'eye')
    info = dict(w=w, h=h, l=l, lh=lh, cy=cy, hw=hw, hx=hw - hw // 2, hy0=hy0, hy1=hy0 + hh, hz0=hz0, ey=ey, back=l - l // 2,
                top=lh + h)
    return b, info


def quad_tail(b, info, length=10, width=2, droop=-40, segments=2, taper=1):
    y = info['lh'] + info['h'] - 1 - width
    z = info['back']
    seg = length // segments
    parent = 'body'
    for i in range(segments):
        wd = max(1, width - i * taper)
        name = 'tail%d' % (i + 1)
        b.bone(name, parent, (0, y + wd // 2 + 1, z), (droop if i == 0 else 10, 0, 0))
        b.box(name, name, (-(wd // 2), y, z), (wd - wd // 2, y + wd, z + seg))
        parent, z = name, z + seg


def quad_ears(b, info, h=3):
    hx, y, z = info['hx'], info['hy1'], info['hz0'] + 1
    b.pair('ear', 'head', 'head', (hx - 2, y, z), (hx, y + h, z + 1), 'dark')

# --- serpent -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def serpent(segments=6, length=5, width=4, head=(5, 4, 6), neck=6):
    """A body of tapering segments along +Z on the ground, a neck rising at the front and a head with a jaw."""
    b = Body()
    hw, hh, hl = head
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, width // 2, 0))
    b.bone('neck', 'body', (0, width // 2, 0), (-45, 0, 0))
    b.bone('head', 'neck', (0, width // 2, -neck), (45, 0, 0))
    b.bone('jaw', 'head', (0, 1, -neck))
    b.box('neck', 'neck', (-width // 2, 0, -neck), (width - width // 2, width, 0))
    b.box('head', 'head', (-hw // 2, 1, -neck - hl), (hw - hw // 2, 1 + hh, -neck + 1))
    b.box('jaw', 'jaw', (-hw // 2 + 1, 0, -neck - hl + 1), (hw - hw // 2 - 1, 1, -neck), 'belly')
    b.pair('eye', 'head', 'head', (hw // 2 - 2, hh - 1, -neck - hl - 1), (hw // 2 - 1, hh, -neck - hl), 'eye')
    b.box('tongue', 'jaw', (0, 0, -neck - hl - 2), (1, 1, -neck - hl + 1), 'membrane')
    parent, z = 'body', 0
    for i in range(segments):
        w = max(1, width - (i * width) // (segments + 1))
        name = 'seg%d' % (i + 1)
        b.bone(name, parent, (0, w // 2, z))
        b.box(name, name, (-(w // 2), 0, z), (w - w // 2, w, z + length))
        if i < segments - 1 and i % 2 == 0:
            b.box(name + '_ridge', name, (0, w, z + 1), (1, w + 1, z + length - 1), 'dark')
        parent, z = name, z + length
    b.box('rattle', parent, (0, 0, z), (1, 1, z + 2), 'horn')
    return b, dict(segments=segments, width=width)

# --- spider --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def spider(body=(8, 5, 7), abdomen=(10, 8, 11), leg=(12, 9), eyes=8):
    """Cephalothorax + abdomen, fangs, eight two-segment legs fanned forward to back."""
    b = Body()
    w, h, l = body
    aw, ah, al = abdomen
    reach, lh = leg
    y0 = lh - 2
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, y0 + h // 2, 0))
    b.bone('abdomen', 'body', (0, y0 + h // 2, l // 2), (-12, 0, 0))
    b.bone_pair('fang', 'body', 'body', (2, y0 + 1, -l // 2))
    b.box('body', 'body', (-w // 2, y0, -l // 2), (w - w // 2, y0 + h, l - l // 2))
    b.box('abdomen', 'abdomen', (-aw // 2, y0 - 1, l // 2), (aw - aw // 2, y0 - 1 + ah, l // 2 + al))
    b.box('mark', 'abdomen', (-2, y0 - 1 + ah, l // 2 + 3), (2, y0 + ah, l // 2 + al - 3), 'belly')
    b.pair('fang', 'fang_l', 'fang_r', (1, y0 - 2, -l // 2 - 2), (3, y0 + 1, -l // 2), 'horn')
    for i in range(eyes // 2):
        ex, ey = 1 + (i % 2) * 2, y0 + h - 2 - (i // 2) * 2
        b.pair('eye%d' % i, 'body', 'body', (ex - 1 + (i // 2), ey, -l // 2 - 1), (ex + (i // 2), ey + 1, -l // 2), 'eye')
    for i, yaw in enumerate((-50, -18, 18, 45)):
        z = -l // 2 + 1 + i * (l - 2) // 3
        up, low = 'leg%d' % (i + 1), 'knee%d' % (i + 1)
        b.bone_pair(up, 'body', 'body', (w // 2, y0 + h // 2, z), (0, yaw, -20))
        b.bone(low + '_l', up + '_l', (w // 2 + reach // 2, y0 + h // 2, z), (0, 0, 75))
        b.bone(low + '_r', up + '_r', (-(w // 2 + reach // 2), y0 + h // 2, z), (0, 0, -75))
        b.pair(up, up + '_l', up + '_r', (w // 2, y0 + h // 2 - 1, z - 1), (w // 2 + reach // 2, y0 + h // 2 + 1, z + 1))
        b.pair(low, low + '_l', low + '_r', (w // 2 + reach // 2, y0 + h // 2 - 1, z - 1), (w // 2 + reach, y0 + h // 2, z), 'dark')
    return b, dict(lh=lh)

def blob(base=(14, 6), mid=(11, 4), top=(7, 3), bubbles=6):
    b = Body()
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('top', 'body', (0, base[1] + mid[1], 0))
    y = 0
    for name, (w, h), bone in (('base', base, 'body'), ('mid', mid, 'body'), ('top', top, 'top')):
        b.box(name, bone, (-w // 2, y, -w // 2), (w - w // 2, y + h, w - w // 2), 'membrane' if name == 'base' else 'base')
        y += h
    spots = [(-base[0] // 2 - 1, 2, -2), (base[0] // 2, 3, 1), (-2, 1, -base[0] // 2 - 1), (1, 4, base[0] // 2), (-mid[0] // 2 - 1, base[1] + 1, 0), (2, base[1] + 2, -mid[0] // 2 - 1)]
    for i, (sx, sy, sz) in enumerate(spots[:bubbles]):
        b.box('bubble%d' % i, 'body', (sx, sy, sz), (sx + 1, sy + 1, sz + 1), 'eye')
    return b, {}

def elemental(torso=(10, 9, 6), head=(6, 6, 6), fist=(4, 5), float_y=6, swirl=3):
    """A torso over a spinning vortex of shrinking rings, heavy fists on short arms, no legs."""
    b = Body()
    tw, th, td = torso
    hw, hh, hd = head
    fw, fh = fist
    ty = float_y + 4 * swirl
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, ty, 0))
    b.bone('head', 'body', (0, ty + th, 0))
    b.bone_pair('arm', 'body', 'body', (tw // 2 + 1, ty + th - 2, 0))
    b.box('torso', 'body', (-tw // 2, ty, -td // 2), (tw - tw // 2, ty + th, td - td // 2))
    b.box('core', 'body', (-2, ty + 3, -td // 2 - 1), (2, ty + 6, -td // 2), 'eye')
    b.box('head', 'head', (-hw // 2, ty + th, -hd // 2), (hw - hw // 2, ty + th + hh, hd - hd // 2))
    b.pair('eye', 'head', 'head', (1, ty + th + hh // 2, -hd // 2 - 1), (2, ty + th + hh // 2 + 1, -hd // 2), 'eye')
    b.pair('shoulder', 'arm_l', 'arm_r', (tw - tw // 2, ty + th - 4, -2), (tw - tw // 2 + 3, ty + th, 2), 'membrane')
    b.pair('fist', 'arm_l', 'arm_r', (tw - tw // 2, ty + th - 4 - fh, -fw // 2), (tw - tw // 2 + fw, ty + th - 4, fw - fw // 2))
    parent, y, w = 'body', ty, tw - 2
    for i in range(swirl):
        name = 'swirl%d' % (i + 1)
        b.bone(name, parent, (0, y, 0))
        b.box(name, name, (-w // 2, y - 4, -w // 2), (w - w // 2, y, w - w // 2), 'membrane' if i % 2 else 'base')
        parent, y, w = name, y - 4, max(2, w - 3)
    return b, dict(swirl=swirl)

    b = Body()

    hw, hh, hl = head
    lh = leg
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, lh + h // 2, 0), (-10, 0, 0))
    b.bone('head', 'body', (0, lh + h, -l // 2 + 1), (10, 0, 0))
    b.bone_pair('wing', 'body', 'body', (w // 2, lh + h, 0))
    b.bone('tail', 'body', (0, lh + h - 2, l // 2))
    b.bone_pair('leg', 'body', 'body', (1, lh, 0))
    b.box('body', 'body', (-w // 2, lh, -l // 2), (w - w // 2, lh + h, l - l // 2))
    hy, hz = lh + h - 2, -l // 2 - hl + 2
    b.box('head', 'head', (-hw // 2, hy, hz), (hw - hw // 2, hy + hh, hz + hl))

"""Body plans shared by the creature archetypes: each builds bones + cubes from a few proportions and returns the
anchor points the archetype hangs its extras on (ears, horns, tusks, tails, wings), plus one animation set per plan.
So an archetype script is proportions + extras + palettes, and every biped animates the same way.

Conventions (as the dragon): the model faces -Z, +Y is up, '_l' is +X and '_r' its mirror at -X.
Bedrock rotation signs used in the animations: on X, negative swings a hanging limb forward and lifts a forward-pointing
part (jaw tip, neck); positive tilts a standing part (torso, head) forward. On Z, positive lifts a +X limb (left wing)."""
import math
from mobkit import Cube, keys


class Body:
    def __init__(self):
        self.bones, self.cubes = [], []

    def bone(self, name, parent, pivot, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
        self.bones.append((name, parent, list(pivot), list(rot)))

    def bone_pair(self, name, parent_l, parent_r, pivot, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
        x, y, z = pivot
        self.bone(name + '_l', parent_l, (x, y, z), rot)
        self.bone(name + '_r', parent_r, (-x, y, z), (rot[0], -rot[1], -rot[2]))

    def box(self, name, bone, a, b, role='base'):
        self.cubes.append(Cube(name, bone, tuple(a), tuple(b), role))

    def pair(self, name, bone_l, bone_r, a, b, role='base'):
        """Left cube + mirrored right cube sharing one painted net."""
        (ax, ay, az), (bx, by, bz) = a, b
        self.cubes.append(Cube(name + '_l', bone_l, (ax, ay, az), (bx, by, bz), role, uvkey=name))
        self.cubes.append(Cube(name + '_r', bone_r, (-bx, ay, az), (-ax, by, bz), role, uvkey=name))


# --- animation helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def anim(length, bones, loop=True):
    a = {'animation_length': length, 'bones': {b: {ch: keys(length, fr) for ch, fr in chans.items()} for b, chans in bones.items()}}
    a['loop'] = True if loop else 'hold_on_last_frame'
    return a


def sway(length, amp, axis=1, phase=0.0, n=8, base=0.0):
    """A sine loop on one axis, sampled n times (GeckoLib interpolates linearly between)."""
    out = {}
    for i in range(n + 1):
        v = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        v[axis] = round(base + amp * math.sin(2 * math.pi * (i / n + phase)), 2)
        out[round(length * i / n, 3)] = v
    return out


def spin(length, turns=1):
    return {round(length * i / 4, 3): [0, 90 * i * turns, 0] for i in range(5)}


def x(**frames):
    return {float(k[1:].replace('_', '.')): [v, 0, 0] for k, v in frames.items()}


def mirror(chans):
    """The right-side copy of a left-side channel set: Y and Z rotations flip."""
    out = {}
    for ch, frames in chans.items():
        out[ch] = {t: ([v[0], -v[1], -v[2]] if ch == 'rotation' else ([-v[0], v[1], v[2]] if ch == 'position' else v)) for t, v in frames.items()}
    return out


def both(name, chans):
    return {name + '_l': chans, name + '_r': mirror(chans)}


# --- biped ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def biped(leg=(3, 10), gap=1, torso=(8, 10, 5), head=(8, 7, 7), arm=(3, 12), hunch=0, sink=0, head_fwd=0,
          clothes=('torso', 'legs'), arm_rest=0, chest=True):
    """Two legs, torso, head, two arms (with empty item_r/item_l bones at the hands for held items).
    sink: how far the head sits down between the shoulders. Returns (body, info)."""
    b = Body()
    lw, lh = leg
    tw, th, td = torso
    hw, hh, hd = head
    aw, al = arm
    top = lh + th
    hy0 = top - sink
    hz0 = -hd // 2 - head_fwd
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, lh, 0), (hunch, 0, 0))
    b.bone('head', 'body', (0, top, 0), (-round(hunch * 0.7), 0, 0))
    b.bone_pair('arm', 'body', 'body', (tw // 2 + aw // 2, top - 1, 0), (arm_rest, 0, 0))
    b.bone('item_r', 'arm_r', (-(tw // 2 + aw // 2), top - al + 1, -1))
    b.bone('item_l', 'arm_l', (tw // 2 + aw // 2, top - al + 1, -1))
    b.bone_pair('leg', 'root', 'root', (gap + lw // 2, lh, 0))

    half = lw // 2
    b.pair('leg', 'leg_l', 'leg_r', (gap, 1, -half), (gap + lw, lh, lw - half), 'membrane' if 'legs' in clothes else 'base')
    b.pair('foot', 'leg_l', 'leg_r', (gap, 0, -half - 1), (gap + lw, 1, lw - half), 'dark')
    b.box('torso', 'body', (-tw // 2, lh, -td // 2), (tw - tw // 2, top, td - td // 2), 'membrane' if 'torso' in clothes else 'base')
    if chest:
        b.box('chest', 'body', (-tw // 2 + 1, lh + th // 2, -td // 2 - 1), (tw - tw // 2 - 1, top - 1, -td // 2), 'belly')
    b.box('head', 'head', (-hw // 2, hy0, hz0), (hw - hw // 2, hy0 + hh, hz0 + hd))
    ey = hy0 + max(2, hh * 11 // 20)
    b.pair('eye', 'head', 'head', (1, ey, hz0 - 1), (min(3, hw // 2), ey + 1, hz0), 'eye')
    b.pair('arm', 'arm_l', 'arm_r', (tw - tw // 2, top - al, -aw // 2), (tw - tw // 2 + aw, top, aw - aw // 2))
    b.pair('hand', 'arm_l', 'arm_r', (tw - tw // 2, top - al - 1, -aw // 2), (tw - tw // 2 + aw, top - al, aw - aw // 2), 'dark')
    info = dict(lh=lh, top=top, tw=tw, td=td, hw=hw, hh=hh, hd=hd, hx=hw - hw // 2, hy0=hy0, hy1=hy0 + hh, hz0=hz0, hz1=hz0 + hd,
                ey=ey, shoulder=top - 1, back=td - td // 2, aw=aw, al=al)
    return b, info


def biped_tail(b, info, length=12, width=3, tip_role='base', segments=2):
    y = info['lh'] + 1
    z = info['back']
    seg = length // segments
    parent = 'body'
    for i in range(segments):
        w = max(1, width - i)
        name = 'tail%d' % (i + 1)
        b.bone(name, parent, (0, y + w // 2, z), (-35 if i == 0 else 10, 0, 0))
        b.box(name, name, (-(w // 2), y, z), (w - w // 2, y + w, z + seg))
        parent, z = name, z + seg
    b.box('tail_tip', parent, (-1, y - 1, z), (1, y + 2, z + 3), tip_role)


def biped_wings(b, info, span=16, height=12):
    """Bat wings on the back: a bone bar along the top edge and a membrane hanging under it, swept back."""
    sy, z = info['shoulder'], info['back']
    b.bone_pair('wing', 'body', 'body', (2, sy, z), (0, -25, 15))
    b.pair('wing_bar', 'wing_l', 'wing_r', (2, sy - 1, z), (2 + span, sy + 1, z + 2), 'horn')
    b.pair('wing_skin', 'wing_l', 'wing_r', (3, sy - height, z + 1), (2 + span, sy - 1, z + 2), 'membrane')


def horns(b, info, rise=4, out=2, thick=2, curl=True):
    """A pair of horns from the top corners of the head, curling outward and back."""
    hx, y, z = info['hx'], info['hy1'], info['hz0'] + 2
    b.pair('horn', 'head', 'head', (hx - thick, y, z), (hx, y + rise, z + thick), 'horn')
    if curl:
        b.pair('horn_tip', 'head', 'head', (hx, y + rise - thick, z + thick - 1), (hx + out, y + rise, z + thick + 1), 'horn')


def pointed_ears(b, info, length=4):
    hx, y, z = info['hx'], info['ey'], info['hz0'] + 2
    b.pair('ear', 'head', 'head', (hx, y, z), (hx + length, y + 2, z + 1))
    b.pair('ear_tip', 'head', 'head', (hx + length, y + 1, z), (hx + length + 2, y + 3, z + 1), 'dark')


def tusks(b, info):
    y, z = info['hy0'], info['hz0']
    b.pair('tusk', 'head', 'head', (1, y, z - 1), (2, y + 3, z), 'horn')


def brow(b, info):
    hx = info['hx']
    b.box('brow', 'head', (-hx, info['ey'] + 1, info['hz0'] - 1), (hx, info['ey'] + 2, info['hz0']), 'dark')


def snout(b, info, w=4, h=3, length=4, role='base'):
    y, z = info['hy0'], info['hz0']
    b.box('snout', 'head', (-w // 2, y, z - length), (w - w // 2, y + h, z), role)
    b.box('nostril', 'head', (-w // 2, y + h - 1, z - length - 1), (w - w // 2, y + h, z - length), 'dark')


def biped_anims(heavy=False):
    """idle / fly (wings, legs dangling) / attack (right arm overhead swing) / hurt / death (falls on its back)."""
    slow = 1.4 if heavy else 1.0
    return {
        'idle': anim(3.0, {
            'body': {'position': {0: [0, 0, 0], 1.5: [0, 0.4, 0], 3: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'head': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 7)},
            'arm_l': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 3, axis=0)},
            'arm_r': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 3, axis=0, phase=0.5)},
            'tail1': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 12)},
            'tail2': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 16, phase=0.2)},
            'wing_l': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 4, axis=2)},
            'wing_r': {'rotation': sway(3.0, -4, axis=2)},
        }),
        'fly': anim(0.8, {
            'body': {'position': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.4: [0, -1, 0], 0.8: [0, 0, 0]}},
            **both('wing', {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 25], 0.4: [0, 0, -30], 0.8: [0, 0, 25]}}),
            'leg_l': {'rotation': {0: [15, 0, 0], 0.8: [15, 0, 0]}},
            'leg_r': {'rotation': {0: [22, 0, 0], 0.8: [22, 0, 0]}},
            'tail1': {'rotation': sway(0.8, 10)},
        }),
        'attack': anim(0.7 * slow, {
            'arm_r': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.25 * slow: [-140, 0, 0], 0.45 * slow: [-20, 0, 0], 0.7 * slow: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'arm_l': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.25 * slow: [-25, 0, 0], 0.7 * slow: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'body': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.25 * slow: [-6, 12, 0], 0.45 * slow: [10, -14, 0], 0.7 * slow: [0, 0, 0]}},
        }, loop=False),
        'hurt': anim(0.4, {
            'body': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.1: [-10, 0, 0], 0.4: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'head': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.1: [-15, 0, 0], 0.4: [0, 0, 0]}},
        }, loop=False),
        'death': anim(1.2 * slow, {
            'root': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.9 * slow: [-88, 0, 0], 1.2 * slow: [-90, 0, 0]}},
            **both('arm', {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.9 * slow: [-20, 0, 40]}}),
            'head': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.9 * slow: [-15, 0, 0]}},
        }, loop=False),
    }


# --- quadruped -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def quadruped(body=(8, 7, 16), leg=(3, 8), head=(6, 6, 5), muzzle=(4, 3, 4), splay=False, rise=2):
    """Four legs, a body, a head with an upper muzzle and an opening jaw. splay = lizard legs out at the sides."""
    b = Body()
    w, h, l = body
    lw, lh = leg
    hw, hh, hl = head
    mw, mh, ml = muzzle
    cy = lh + h // 2
    hy0 = lh + h - hh // 2 + rise
    hz0 = -l // 2 - hl + 2
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, cy, 0))
    b.bone('head', 'body', (0, hy0 + hh // 2, -l // 2))
    b.bone('jaw', 'head', (0, hy0 + 1, hz0))
    lx = w // 2 + (lw // 2 if splay else -lw // 2)
    fz, bz = -l // 2 + lw // 2 + 1, l // 2 - lw // 2 - 1
    for side, sx in (('l', 1), ('r', -1)):
        b.bone('leg_f' + side, 'body', (sx * lx, lh, fz))
        b.bone('leg_b' + side, 'body', (sx * lx, lh, bz))
    b.box('body', 'body', (-w // 2, lh, -l // 2), (w - w // 2, lh + h, l - l // 2))
    x0 = w - w // 2 if splay else w - w // 2 - lw
    for name, z in (('leg_f', fz), ('leg_b', bz)):
        b.pair(name, name + 'l', name + 'r', (x0, 1, z - lw // 2), (x0 + lw, lh + (1 if splay else 2), z - lw // 2 + lw))
        b.pair(name.replace('leg', 'paw'), name + 'l', name + 'r', (x0, 0, z - lw // 2 - 1), (x0 + lw, 1, z - lw // 2 + lw), 'claw')
    b.box('head', 'head', (-hw // 2, hy0, hz0), (hw - hw // 2, hy0 + hh, hz0 + hl))
    jh = max(1, mh // 3)
    b.box('muzzle', 'head', (-mw // 2, hy0 + jh, hz0 - ml), (mw - mw // 2, hy0 + mh, hz0))
    b.box('nose', 'head', (-1, hy0 + mh - 1, hz0 - ml - 1), (1, hy0 + mh, hz0 - ml), 'dark')
    b.box('jaw', 'jaw', (-mw // 2 + (1 if mw > 3 else 0), hy0, hz0 - ml + 1), (mw - mw // 2 - (1 if mw > 3 else 0), hy0 + jh, hz0), 'belly')
    ey = hy0 + hh - 2
    b.pair('eye', 'head', 'head', (hw // 2 - 2, ey, hz0 - 1), (hw // 2 - 1, ey + 1, hz0), 'eye')
    info = dict(w=w, h=h, l=l, lh=lh, cy=cy, hw=hw, hx=hw - hw // 2, hy0=hy0, hy1=hy0 + hh, hz0=hz0, ey=ey, back=l - l // 2,
                top=lh + h)
    return b, info


def quad_tail(b, info, length=10, width=2, droop=-40, segments=2, taper=1):
    y = info['lh'] + info['h'] - 1 - width
    z = info['back']
    seg = length // segments
    parent = 'body'
    for i in range(segments):
        wd = max(1, width - i * taper)
        name = 'tail%d' % (i + 1)
        b.bone(name, parent, (0, y + wd // 2 + 1, z), (droop if i == 0 else 10, 0, 0))
        b.box(name, name, (-(wd // 2), y, z), (wd - wd // 2, y + wd, z + seg))
        parent, z = name, z + seg


def quad_ears(b, info, h=3):
    hx, y, z = info['hx'], info['hy1'], info['hz0'] + 1
    b.pair('ear', 'head', 'head', (hx - 2, y, z), (hx, y + h, z + 1), 'dark')


def quad_anims(info):
    drop = round(info['w'] / 2 - info['cy'], 1)
    return {
        'idle': anim(3.0, {
            'body': {'position': {0: [0, 0, 0], 1.5: [0, 0.3, 0], 3: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'head': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.8: [3, 9, 0], 1.6: [-2, 0, 0], 2.3: [3, -9, 0], 3: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'jaw': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 2.6: [0, 0, 0], 2.8: [8, 0, 0], 3: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'tail1': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 14)},
            'tail2': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 18, phase=0.15)},
            'tail3': {'rotation': sway(3.0, 22, phase=0.3)},
        }),
        'attack': anim(0.7, {
            'body': {'position': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.2: [0, 0, 1.5], 0.4: [0, -0.5, -2.5], 0.7: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'head': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.2: [-15, 0, 0], 0.4: [20, 0, 0], 0.7: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'jaw': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.2: [38, 0, 0], 0.42: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'leg_fl': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.3: [-30, 0, 0], 0.7: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'leg_fr': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.35: [-20, 0, 0], 0.7: [0, 0, 0]}},
        }, loop=False),
        'hurt': anim(0.4, {
            'body': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.1: [0, 0, 6], 0.25: [0, 0, -4], 0.4: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'head': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.1: [-15, 0, 0], 0.4: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'jaw': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.1: [20, 0, 0], 0.4: [0, 0, 0]}},
        }, loop=False),
        'death': anim(1.3, {
            'body': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 1.0: [0, 0, 84], 1.3: [0, 0, 90]}, 'position': {0: [0, 0, 0], 1.0: [0, drop, 0], 1.3: [0, drop, 0]}},
            'head': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 1.0: [10, 0, 0]}},
            'jaw': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 1.0: [25, 0, 0]}},
        }, loop=False),
    }


# --- serpent -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def serpent(segments=6, length=5, width=4, head=(5, 4, 6), neck=6):
    """A body of tapering segments along +Z on the ground, a neck rising at the front and a head with a jaw."""
    b = Body()
    hw, hh, hl = head
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, width // 2, 0))
    b.bone('neck', 'body', (0, width // 2, 0), (-45, 0, 0))
    b.bone('head', 'neck', (0, width // 2, -neck), (45, 0, 0))
    b.bone('jaw', 'head', (0, 1, -neck))
    b.box('neck', 'neck', (-width // 2, 0, -neck), (width - width // 2, width, 0))
    b.box('head', 'head', (-hw // 2, 1, -neck - hl), (hw - hw // 2, 1 + hh, -neck + 1))
    b.box('jaw', 'jaw', (-hw // 2 + 1, 0, -neck - hl + 1), (hw - hw // 2 - 1, 1, -neck), 'belly')
    b.pair('eye', 'head', 'head', (hw // 2 - 2, hh - 1, -neck - hl - 1), (hw // 2 - 1, hh, -neck - hl), 'eye')
    b.box('tongue', 'jaw', (0, 0, -neck - hl - 2), (1, 1, -neck - hl + 1), 'membrane')
    parent, z = 'body', 0
    for i in range(segments):
        w = max(1, width - (i * width) // (segments + 1))
        name = 'seg%d' % (i + 1)
        b.bone(name, parent, (0, w // 2, z))
        b.box(name, name, (-(w // 2), 0, z), (w - w // 2, w, z + length))
        if i < segments - 1 and i % 2 == 0:
            b.box(name + '_ridge', name, (0, w, z + 1), (1, w + 1, z + length - 1), 'dark')
        parent, z = name, z + length
    b.box('rattle', parent, (0, 0, z), (1, 1, z + 2), 'horn')
    return b, dict(segments=segments, width=width)


def serpent_anims(info):
    n = info['segments']
    sw = {'seg%d' % (i + 1): {'rotation': sway(2.4, 10 + i, phase=-0.12 * i)} for i in range(n)}
    return {
        'idle': anim(2.4, {**sw, 'neck': {'rotation': sway(2.4, 4, axis=0)}, 'head': {'rotation': sway(2.4, 8)},
                           'jaw': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 2.0: [0, 0, 0], 2.2: [12, 0, 0], 2.4: [0, 0, 0]}}}),
        'fly': anim(2.4, {**sw, 'body': {'position': {0: [0, 0, 0], 1.2: [0, 1.5, 0], 2.4: [0, 0, 0]}}}),
        'attack': anim(0.6, {
            'neck': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.2: [-25, 0, 0], 0.38: [35, 0, 0], 0.6: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'head': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.38: [10, 0, 0], 0.6: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'jaw': {'rotation': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.2: [45, 0, 0], 0.45: [0, 0, 0]}},
            'body': {'position': {0: [0, 0, 0], 0.38: [0, 0, -3], 0.6: [0, 0, 0]}},
        }, loop=False),

"""Body plans shared by the creature archetypes: each builds bones + cubes from a few proportions and returns the
anchor points the archetype hangs its extras on (ears, horns, tusks, tails, wings), plus one animation set per plan.
So an archetype script is proportions + extras + palettes, and every biped animates the same way.

Conventions (as the dragon): the model faces -Z, +Y is up, '_l' is +X and '_r' its mirror at -X.
Bedrock rotation signs used in the animations: on X, negative swings a hanging limb forward and lifts a forward-pointing
part (jaw tip, neck); positive tilts a standing part (torso, head) forward. On Z, positive lifts a +X limb (left wing)."""
import math
from mobkit import Cube, keys


class Body:
    def __init__(self):
        self.bones, self.cubes = [], []

    def bone(self, name, parent, pivot, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
        self.bones.append((name, parent, list(pivot), list(rot)))

    def bone_pair(self, name, parent_l, parent_r, pivot, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
        x, y, z = pivot
        self.bone(name + '_l', parent_l, (x, y, z), rot)
        self.bone(name + '_r', parent_r, (-x, y, z), (rot[0], -rot[1], -rot[2]))

    def box(self, name, bone, a, b, role='base'):
        self.cubes.append(Cube(name, bone, tuple(a), tuple(b), role))

    def pair(self, name, bone_l, bone_r, a, b, role='base'):
        """Left cube + mirrored right cube sharing one painted net."""
        (ax, ay, az), (bx, by, bz) = a, b
        self.cubes.append(Cube(name + '_l', bone_l, (ax, ay, az), (bx, by, bz), role, uvkey=name))
        self.cubes.append(Cube(name + '_r', bone_r, (-bx, ay, az), (-ax, by, bz), role, uvkey=name))


# --- animation helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def anim(length, bones, loop=True):
    a = {'animation_length': length, 'bones': {b: {ch: keys(length, fr) for ch, fr in chans.items()} for b, chans in bones.items()}}
    a['loop'] = True if loop else 'hold_on_last_frame'
    return a


def sway(length, amp, axis=1, phase=0.0, n=8, base=0.0):
    """A sine loop on one axis, sampled n times (GeckoLib interpolates linearly between)."""
    out = {}
    for i in range(n + 1):
        v = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        v[axis] = round(base + amp * math.sin(2 * math.pi * (i / n + phase)), 2)
        out[round(length * i / n, 3)] = v
    return out


def spin(length, turns=1):
    return {round(length * i / 4, 3): [0, 90 * i * turns, 0] for i in range(5)}


def x(**frames):
    return {float(k[1:].replace('_', '.')): [v, 0, 0] for k, v in frames.items()}


def mirror(chans):
    """The right-side copy of a left-side channel set: Y and Z rotations flip."""
    out = {}
    for ch, frames in chans.items():
        out[ch] = {t: ([v[0], -v[1], -v[2]] if ch == 'rotation' else ([-v[0], v[1], v[2]] if ch == 'position' else v)) for t, v in frames.items()}
    return out


def both(name, chans):
    return {name + '_l': chans, name + '_r': mirror(chans)}


# --- biped ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def biped(leg=(3, 10), gap=1, torso=(8, 10, 5), head=(8, 7, 7), arm=(3, 12), hunch=0, sink=0, head_fwd=0,
          clothes=('torso', 'legs'), arm_rest=0, chest=True):
    """Two legs, torso, head, two arms (with empty item_r/item_l bones at the hands for held items).
    sink: how far the head sits down between the shoulders. Returns (body, info)."""
    b = Body()
    lw, lh = leg
    tw, th, td = torso
    hw, hh, hd = head
    aw, al = arm
    top = lh + th
    hy0 = top - sink
    hz0 = -hd // 2 - head_fwd
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, lh, 0), (hunch, 0, 0))
    b.bone('head', 'body', (0, top, 0), (-round(hunch * 0.7), 0, 0))
    b.bone_pair('arm', 'body', 'body', (tw // 2 + aw // 2, top - 1, 0), (arm_rest, 0, 0))
    b.bone('item_r', 'arm_r', (-(tw // 2 + aw // 2), top - al + 1, -1))
    b.bone('item_l', 'arm_l', (tw // 2 + aw // 2, top - al + 1, -1))
    b.bone_pair('leg', 'root', 'root', (gap + lw // 2, lh, 0))

    half = lw // 2
    b.pair('leg', 'leg_l', 'leg_r', (gap, 1, -half), (gap + lw, lh, lw - half), 'membrane' if 'legs' in clothes else 'base')
    b.pair('foot', 'leg_l', 'leg_r', (gap, 0, -half - 1), (gap + lw, 1, lw - half), 'dark')
    b.box('torso', 'body', (-tw // 2, lh, -td // 2), (tw - tw // 2, top, td - td // 2), 'membrane' if 'torso' in clothes else 'base')
    if chest:
        b.box('chest', 'body', (-tw // 2 + 1, lh + th // 2, -td // 2 - 1), (tw - tw // 2 - 1, top - 1, -td // 2), 'belly')
    b.box('head', 'head', (-hw // 2, hy0, hz0), (hw - hw // 2, hy0 + hh, hz0 + hd))
    ey = hy0 + max(2, hh * 11 // 20)
    b.pair('eye', 'head', 'head', (1, ey, hz0 - 1), (min(3, hw // 2), ey + 1, hz0), 'eye')
    b.pair('arm', 'arm_l', 'arm_r', (tw - tw // 2, top - al, -aw // 2), (tw - tw // 2 + aw, top, aw - aw // 2))
    b.pair('hand', 'arm_l', 'arm_r', (tw - tw // 2, top - al - 1, -aw // 2), (tw - tw // 2 + aw, top - al, aw - aw // 2), 'dark')
    info = dict(lh=lh, top=top, tw=tw, td=td, hw=hw, hh=hh, hd=hd, hx=hw - hw // 2, hy0=hy0, hy1=hy0 + hh, hz0=hz0, hz1=hz0 + hd,
                ey=ey, shoulder=top - 1, back=td - td // 2, aw=aw, al=al)
    return b, info


def biped_tail(b, info, length=12, width=3, tip_role='base', segments=2):

    parent = 'body'
    for i in range(segments):
        w = max(1, width - i)
        name = 'tail%d' % (i + 1)
        b.bone(name, parent, (0, y + w // 2, z), (-35 if i == 0 else 10, 0, 0))
        b.box(name, name, (-(w // 2), y, z), (w - w // 2, y + w, z + seg))
        parent, z = name, z + seg
    b.box('tail_tip', parent, (-1, y - 1, z), (1, y + 2, z + 3), tip_role)

# --- quadruped -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def quadruped(body=(8, 7, 16), leg=(3, 8), head=(6, 6, 5), muzzle=(4, 3, 4), splay=False, rise=2):
    """Four legs, a body, a head with an upper muzzle and an opening jaw. splay = lizard legs out at the sides."""
    b = Body()
    w, h, l = body
    lw, lh = leg
    hw, hh, hl = head
    mw, mh, ml = muzzle
    cy = lh + h // 2
    hy0 = lh + h - hh // 2 + rise
    hz0 = -l // 2 - hl + 2
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, cy, 0))
    b.bone('head', 'body', (0, hy0 + hh // 2, -l // 2))
    b.bone('jaw', 'head', (0, hy0 + 1, hz0))
    lx = w // 2 + (lw // 2 if splay else -lw // 2)
    fz, bz = -l // 2 + lw // 2 + 1, l // 2 - lw // 2 - 1
    for side, sx in (('l', 1), ('r', -1)):
        b.bone('leg_f' + side, 'body', (sx * lx, lh, fz))
        b.bone('leg_b' + side, 'body', (sx * lx, lh, bz))
    b.box('body', 'body', (-w // 2, lh, -l // 2), (w - w // 2, lh + h, l - l // 2))
    x0 = w - w // 2 if splay else w - w // 2 - lw
    for name, z in (('leg_f', fz), ('leg_b', bz)):
        b.pair(name, name + 'l', name + 'r', (x0, 1, z - lw // 2), (x0 + lw, lh + (1 if splay else 2), z - lw // 2 + lw))
        b.pair(name.replace('leg', 'paw'), name + 'l', name + 'r', (x0, 0, z - lw // 2 - 1), (x0 + lw, 1, z - lw // 2 + lw), 'claw')
    b.box('head', 'head', (-hw // 2, hy0, hz0), (hw - hw // 2, hy0 + hh, hz0 + hl))
    jh = max(1, mh // 3)
    b.box('muzzle', 'head', (-mw // 2, hy0 + jh, hz0 - ml), (mw - mw // 2, hy0 + mh, hz0))
    b.box('nose', 'head', (-1, hy0 + mh - 1, hz0 - ml - 1), (1, hy0 + mh, hz0 - ml), 'dark')
    b.box('jaw', 'jaw', (-mw // 2 + (1 if mw > 3 else 0), hy0, hz0 - ml + 1), (mw - mw // 2 - (1 if mw > 3 else 0), hy0 + jh, hz0), 'belly')
    ey = hy0 + hh - 2
    b.pair('eye', 'head', 'head', (hw // 2 - 2, ey, hz0 - 1), (hw // 2 - 1, ey + 1, hz0), 'eye')
    info = dict(w=w, h=h, l=l, lh=lh, cy=cy, hw=hw, hx=hw - hw // 2, hy0=hy0, hy1=hy0 + hh, hz0=hz0, ey=ey, back=l - l // 2,
                top=lh + h)
    return b, info

# --- serpent -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def serpent(segments=6, length=5, width=4, head=(5, 4, 6), neck=6):
    """A body of tapering segments along +Z on the ground, a neck rising at the front and a head with a jaw."""
    b = Body()
    hw, hh, hl = head
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, width // 2, 0))
    b.bone('neck', 'body', (0, width // 2, 0), (-45, 0, 0))
    b.bone('head', 'neck', (0, width // 2, -neck), (45, 0, 0))
    b.bone('jaw', 'head', (0, 1, -neck))
    b.box('neck', 'neck', (-width // 2, 0, -neck), (width - width // 2, width, 0))
    b.box('head', 'head', (-hw // 2, 1, -neck - hl), (hw - hw // 2, 1 + hh, -neck + 1))
    b.box('jaw', 'jaw', (-hw // 2 + 1, 0, -neck - hl + 1), (hw - hw // 2 - 1, 1, -neck), 'belly')
    b.pair('eye', 'head', 'head', (hw // 2 - 2, hh - 1, -neck - hl - 1), (hw // 2 - 1, hh, -neck - hl), 'eye')
    b.box('tongue', 'jaw', (0, 0, -neck - hl - 2), (1, 1, -neck - hl + 1), 'membrane')
    parent, z = 'body', 0
    for i in range(segments):
        w = max(1, width - (i * width) // (segments + 1))
        name = 'seg%d' % (i + 1)
        b.bone(name, parent, (0, w // 2, z))
        b.box(name, name, (-(w // 2), 0, z), (w - w // 2, w, z + length))
        if i < segments - 1 and i % 2 == 0:
            b.box(name + '_ridge', name, (0, w, z + 1), (1, w + 1, z + length - 1), 'dark')
        parent, z = name, z + length
    b.box('rattle', parent, (0, 0, z), (1, 1, z + 2), 'horn')
    return b, dict(segments=segments, width=width)

def spider(body=(8, 5, 7), abdomen=(10, 8, 11), leg=(12, 9), eyes=8):
    """Cephalothorax + abdomen, fangs, eight two-segment legs fanned forward to back."""
    b = Body()
    w, h, l = body
    aw, ah, al = abdomen
    reach, lh = leg
    y0 = lh - 2
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, y0 + h // 2, 0))
    b.bone('abdomen', 'body', (0, y0 + h // 2, l // 2), (-12, 0, 0))
    b.bone_pair('fang', 'body', 'body', (2, y0 + 1, -l // 2))
    b.box('body', 'body', (-w // 2, y0, -l // 2), (w - w // 2, y0 + h, l - l // 2))
    b.box('abdomen', 'abdomen', (-aw // 2, y0 - 1, l // 2), (aw - aw // 2, y0 - 1 + ah, l // 2 + al))
    b.box('mark', 'abdomen', (-2, y0 - 1 + ah, l // 2 + 3), (2, y0 + ah, l // 2 + al - 3), 'belly')
    b.pair('fang', 'fang_l', 'fang_r', (1, y0 - 2, -l // 2 - 2), (3, y0 + 1, -l // 2), 'horn')
    for i in range(eyes // 2):
        ex, ey = 1 + (i % 2) * 2, y0 + h - 2 - (i // 2) * 2
        b.pair('eye%d' % i, 'body', 'body', (ex - 1 + (i // 2), ey, -l // 2 - 1), (ex + (i // 2), ey + 1, -l // 2), 'eye')
    for i, yaw in enumerate((-50, -18, 18, 45)):
        z = -l // 2 + 1 + i * (l - 2) // 3
        up, low = 'leg%d' % (i + 1), 'knee%d' % (i + 1)
        b.bone_pair(up, 'body', 'body', (w // 2, y0 + h // 2, z), (0, yaw, -20))
        b.bone(low + '_l', up + '_l', (w // 2 + reach // 2, y0 + h // 2, z), (0, 0, 75))
        b.bone(low + '_r', up + '_r', (-(w // 2 + reach // 2), y0 + h // 2, z), (0, 0, -75))
        b.pair(up, up + '_l', up + '_r', (w // 2, y0 + h // 2 - 1, z - 1), (w // 2 + reach // 2, y0 + h // 2 + 1, z + 1))
        b.pair(low, low + '_l', low + '_r', (w // 2 + reach // 2, y0 + h // 2 - 1, z - 1), (w // 2 + reach, y0 + h // 2, z), 'dark')
    return b, dict(lh=lh)

def blob(base=(14, 6), mid=(11, 4), top=(7, 3), bubbles=6):
    b = Body()
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('top', 'body', (0, base[1] + mid[1], 0))
    y = 0
    for name, (w, h), bone in (('base', base, 'body'), ('mid', mid, 'body'), ('top', top, 'top')):
        b.box(name, bone, (-w // 2, y, -w // 2), (w - w // 2, y + h, w - w // 2), 'membrane' if name == 'base' else 'base')
        y += h
    spots = [(-base[0] // 2 - 1, 2, -2), (base[0] // 2, 3, 1), (-2, 1, -base[0] // 2 - 1), (1, 4, base[0] // 2), (-mid[0] // 2 - 1, base[1] + 1, 0), (2, base[1] + 2, -mid[0] // 2 - 1)]
    for i, (sx, sy, sz) in enumerate(spots[:bubbles]):
        b.box('bubble%d' % i, 'body', (sx, sy, sz), (sx + 1, sy + 1, sz + 1), 'eye')
    return b, {}

def elemental(torso=(10, 9, 6), head=(6, 6, 6), fist=(4, 5), float_y=6, swirl=3):
    """A torso over a spinning vortex of shrinking rings, heavy fists on short arms, no legs."""
    b = Body()
    tw, th, td = torso
    hw, hh, hd = head
    fw, fh = fist
    ty = float_y + 4 * swirl
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, ty, 0))
    b.bone('head', 'body', (0, ty + th, 0))
    b.bone_pair('arm', 'body', 'body', (tw // 2 + 1, ty + th - 2, 0))
    b.box('torso', 'body', (-tw // 2, ty, -td // 2), (tw - tw // 2, ty + th, td - td // 2))
    b.box('core', 'body', (-2, ty + 3, -td // 2 - 1), (2, ty + 6, -td // 2), 'eye')
    b.box('head', 'head', (-hw // 2, ty + th, -hd // 2), (hw - hw // 2, ty + th + hh, hd - hd // 2))
    b.pair('eye', 'head', 'head', (1, ty + th + hh // 2, -hd // 2 - 1), (2, ty + th + hh // 2 + 1, -hd // 2), 'eye')

    parent, y, w = 'body', ty, tw - 2
    for i in range(swirl):

def bird(body=(6, 6, 10), head=(5, 5, 5), leg=4, beak=3, wing=8):

    b = Body()
    w, h, l = body
    hw, hh, hl = head
    lh = leg
    b.bone('root', None, (0, 0, 0))
    b.bone('body', 'root', (0, lh + h // 2, 0), (-10, 0, 0))
    b.bone('head', 'body', (0, lh + h, -l // 2 + 1), (10, 0, 0))
    b.bone_pair('wing', 'body', 'body', (w // 2, lh + h, 0))
    b.bone('tail', 'body', (0, lh + h - 2, l // 2))
    b.bone_pair('leg', 'body', 'body', (1, lh, 0))
    b.box('body', 'body', (-w // 2, lh, -l // 2), (w - w // 2, lh + h, l - l // 2))
    hy, hz = lh + h - 2, -l // 2 - hl + 2
    b.box('head', 'head', (-hw // 2, hy, hz), (hw - hw // 2, hy + hh, hz + hl))
    b.box('beak', 'head', (-1, hy + 1, hz - beak), (1, hy + 3, hz), 'horn')
    b.pair('eye', 'head', 'head', (hw - hw // 2, hy + hh - 2, hz + 1), (hw - hw // 2 + 1, hy + hh - 1, hz + 2), 'eye')

        'goblin': pal('7a9a3a', '4a3a26', 'a08a5a', 'e8dcb0', '6a4a2a', 'ffd040'),

out = '\n'.join(lines)

# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Own creature models, first archetype: the dragon (GeckoLib 4, now a required dependency). All 40 chromatic and
  metallic dragons use it, in their own colour; wyrmlings are drawn at half size. Skin packs for other creature mods still win.

## 2.3.0

Single file: the Dungeon Toolkit and Species addons are now bundled in this jar (CurseForge allows one
file per project). They keep their own mod ids (`dndsheets_dungeon`, `dndsheets_species`). Curios, Patchouli,
Jade, Pehkui and Origins are required dependencies. If you had the separate addon jars installed, delete them.

Rules and content in this release:

- Spells now carry casting time, range, components and duration; range limits how far a spell can be aimed.
- Monsters: Recharge 5-6 abilities, legendary action costs, and the dragon breath weapons and Wing Attack.
- Short rests spend Hit Dice (a long rest returns half); Exhaustion is now a condition with its six levels.
- Rage and Bardic Inspiration have limited uses per rest.
- Fighter Action Surge and Monk ki (Patient Defense, Step of the Wind) in the Turn Actions menu.
- Wild Shape has 2 uses per rest and Twinned Spell costs sorcery points (a long rest returns them).
- Death saves: giving up and three failed saves always kill (even creative, invulnerable or with a totem), a revived character is protected for 5 seconds, monsters stop targeting a downed character, and the downed state is cleared on respawn instead of on the death event.
- Damage while down is a failed death save, and massive damage kills outright.
- Search, Hide (Stealth against nearby monsters' passive Perception: advantage on the next attack) and Ready (one action out of turn, using the reaction) in the Turn Actions menu.
- Difficult terrain (water, cobwebs, soul sand, honey, powder snow, mud, berry bushes, vines) costs double movement in turn mode.
- Brass dragons' sleep breath and silver dragons' paralyzing breath.
- Player experience: a rebuilt character sheet (H key) with Overview, Skills, Combat and Spells tabs, visible modifiers and bonuses, class resource pips and condition glyphs; game-icons.net icons (CC BY 3.0, credited in CREDITS.md) for conditions, spell schools and actions; an animated d20 on attack, spell-attack and death-save rolls; condition glyphs over combatants; a welcome screen on a character's first login; spell details in the Grimoire; Cinzel (OFL) screen titles.
- Slowed and Weakened conditions, a push effect, Flurry of Blows, and lair actions that fire at the start of each round.
- Surprise (a condition the DM sets before the encounter), Magic Resistance on the monsters that have it, and total cover now blocks single-target spells. A creature that can't act has its turn skipped.

## 2.2.1

Metadata only — the mod itself is byte-for-byte the same as 2.2.0.

The optional-dependency list on the mod pages was wrong: it advertised mods this project does not
actually talk to. It now lists exactly what the mod references — the four soft integrations (Curios,
Patchouli, Jade, Pehkui) and the seven creature mods its shipped appearance packs draw from. Mods that
are merely nice to have alongside it are not listed as dependencies, because they are not.

If you are on 2.2.0 there is nothing to gain from updating.

## 2.2.0

**The mod is now called VTT MineRPG.** Only the displayed name changed — the mod id is still
`dndsheets`, so existing character sheets, content packs and worlds keep working untouched. No
migration, nothing to re-create.

### Creatures are finally the right size — with Pehkui (optional)

Every monster now declares its 5e size category, filled in from the SRD for 329 of the 330 shipped
creatures. **149 of them are larger than Medium** (102 Large, 32 Huge, 15 Gargantuan) and until now
an ancient dragon stood exactly as tall as a goblin.

Install [Pehkui](https://modrinth.com/mod/pehkui) and they are drawn at their real scale — the
multiplier comes from the grid space 5e gives each size, so a Large creature is twice a human and a
Gargantuan one is four times. Without Pehkui nothing changes and nothing breaks.

Content packs gain an optional `"size"` field next to `"type"`. Packs written before this release
load exactly as before.

### Stat blocks on your crosshair — with Jade (optional)

Install [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade) and pointing at a creature shows its **AC, HP and
active conditions** straight on the HUD, no menus. Works for monsters, NPCs and other players' sheets.
Without Jade, nothing is added.

Both integrations are soft dependencies: the mod runs exactly as before if you do not install them.

### Under the hood

- Automated tests that run inside a real game world (`runGameTestServer`), covering the link between
  the rules engine and live entities — the part that previously could only be checked by playing.
- Publishing to CurseForge and Modrinth is now a single build command.
- Origins and Apoli resolve from Maven instead of jars checked into the repository.
- Build upgraded to Gradle 8.8.

### Compatibility

Minecraft 1.20.1, Forge. Requires both client and server, as always. Optional: Curios, Patchouli,
Jade, Pehkui.

content.text:
Ya están los 14 modelos nuevos y 144 monstruos los usan. Cada uno conserva su entidad vanilla como respaldo. El `./gradlew build` pasa con todas las comprobaciones, pero todavía no los he visto en el juego: aquí los visores de Blockbench se ven en blanco.

**Modelos generados** (todos pasaron la validación de Blockbench)

| Arquetipo | Monstruos |
|---|---|
| goblinoid | goblin, hobgoblin, bugbear, duergar, deep gnome |
| brute | orco, ogro, troll, minotauro, oni, 5 gigantes |
| reptilian | kobold, lizardfolk |
| demon | 7 diablos, erinyes, balor, imp, quasit |
| undead | zombie, ghoul, ghast, wight, momias, vampire spawn |
| golem | 4 gólems, shield guardian, earth elemental |
| beast | lobos, perros, hienas, jackal, felinos |
| reptile | cocodrilos, lagartos, basilisco |
| serpent | serpientes, nagas, purple worm |
| spider | 5 arañas |
| ooze | 4 oozes, incluido el gelatinous cube |
| elemental | fuego, aire, agua, mephits, magmin |
| bird | halcones, águilas, búhos, buitres, roc |
| shark | tiburones, orca |

Además, el wyvern y el pseudodragón ahora usan el dragón con un color propio en hex. Todos los modelos tienen animaciones de reposo, ataque, daño y muerte; los que vuelan también tienen la de vuelo.

**Respaldo (fallback)**
- El monstruo aparece con su entidad vanilla si apagas la opción `ownCreatureModels`, o si un skin pack de otro mod se aplica a ese monstruo.
- Si en el cliente falta un modelo, se dibuja el dragón en vez de crashear.

**Otros cambios**
- La animación de ataque ya se dispara en todos los ataques de monstruo.
- Los bípedos llevan en la mano el arma de su `appearance`. Cascos y armaduras, en cambio, no se dibujan en los modelos propios.
- La mandíbula del dragón se abría hacia el lado equivocado; ya está corregida.

**Para revisar en `./gradlew runClient`**
- **Rotaciones:** dirección de alas, patas de la araña, inclinación de los bípedos y orientación del arma. Las deduje de las convenciones de Bedrock sin verlas, así que si algo sale al revés es un cambio de signo en `tools/blockbench/mobs/bodies.py`.
- **Respaldo vanilla:** que con `ownCreatureModels=false` aparezcan los vanilla.

Quedaron en vanilla a propósito: humanoides con equipo, esqueletos, osos, caballos y criaturas únicas o compuestas (grifo, quimera, hidra).
